final: WITH dept_counts AS (SELECT ma.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id GROUP BY ma.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM dept_counts), compared AS (SELECT department, member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT department, member_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average FROM compared WHERE share >= average_share
